$description: hitlist.fm design tokens — direction "Gold Standard": amber gold on warm ink. Single source of truth; platform theme files (iOS RadioBugTheme.swift, Android ui/theme/Color.kt + res/values/colors.xml, web tailwind.config.ts) must mirror these values exactly. Drop-in replacement for packages/tokens/tokens.json. Run `node generate.mjs swift|kotlin|css` to print platform snippets. Token NAMES are unchanged from the ON AIR theme, so no call sites break — only hex values change (broadcast red -> amber gold).
rules: Gold (accent) ONLY on interactive elements and at most one hero element per screen.
The sunset gradient (#F5B13D -> #FF5A34, 135deg) is the ONLY gradient — CTA buttons, the hero airplay gauge, and the logo mark. Everything else flat.
CTA label text is INK (#12100E), bold — NOT white. The gradient's gold end is too light for white text. (This reverses the old ON AIR rule of white-on-red.)
Ember (#FF5A34) = LIVE (pulsing) + strongly-rising chart moves + the waveform detection marker. It is the 'hot signal' color and is deliberately distinct from the gold brand.

warning (#FF9F45, orange) = PENDING status. It is orange, NOT amber — amber now reads as brand. error (#FF7A6B) = negative/down; always pair with an icon. Do NOT route error/negative through the brand color anymore (brand is no longer red).
Flat surfaces + a warm-white hairline (border token). No glass/blur on list rows.
textQuaternary only for micro-labels >= 10pt bold uppercase (contrast is borderline).

typography.note: UNCHANGED from ON AIR. Numbers, ranks, ISRC, timestamps in IBM Plex Mono. Android: Sora is a variable font — every Font() needs FontVariation.Settings(weight) (already handled in ui/theme/Type.kt).
